title: Guided heart ultrasound
status: Placeholder wording written by the build team, awaiting clinician sign-off (CR-53)
source: Requested by the team's clinicians, 14 Nov 2026. Wording is a placeholder.
imageNote: Live image would show here. No image is captured or kept in this demo.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.instruction: Get the ultrasound probe and gel ready, as your kit card shows. Lie back, turned a little onto your left side if you can.

steps.title: Beside the breastbone
steps.instruction: Probe just to the left of the breastbone, between the ribs, about the middle of the chest. Marker towards the right shoulder.
steps.lookFor: Look for: a steady view of the heart beating. Hold it still for a few beats.
steps.note: The app does not read the image. Your crew medic and Earth do.

steps.title: Save
steps.instruction: Save. The steps you completed go into the case for your crew medic and Earth.
